messages.author: b7bcce299897df4a
messages.subject: Problem with the gl2fasta function
parts:
Hi,
I have imported and filtered a DARTseq dataset (using gl.read.dart and several other filtering functions), and want now to export the cleaned SNP dataset to downstream ML analysis. But the gl2fasta function returned a "fatal error":

> gl2fasta(dm.f2, method=1, outfile="Foc_SNPs.fasta")
Error in gl2fasta(dm.f2, method = 1, outfile = "Foc_SNPs.fasta") : 
  Fatal Error: Data must include type of alleles in the @loc.all slot.


Indeed my genlight file has nothing in locus.all:

> dm.f2
 /// GENLIGHT OBJECT /////////

 // 84 genotypes,  5,196 binary SNPs, size: 14.6 Mb
 14242 (3.26 %) missing data

 // Basic content
   @gen: list of 84 SNPbin
   @ploidy: ploidy of each individual  (range: 2-2)

 // Optional content
   @ind.names:  84 individual labels
   @loc.names:  5196 locus labels
   @position: integer storing positions of the SNPs
   @pop: population of each individual (group size range: 23-61)
   @other: a list containing: loc.all.misformed  loc.metrics  ind.metrics  history


Looking to the original importation (genlight object dm)
> dm
 /// GENLIGHT OBJECT /////////

 // 93 genotypes,  29,432 binary SNPs, size: 24.5 Mb
 839025 (30.65 %) missing data

 // Basic content
   @gen: list of 93 SNPbin
   @ploidy: ploidy of each individual  (range: 2-2)

 // Optional content
   @ind.names:  93 individual labels
   @loc.names:  29432 locus labels
   @position: integer storing positions of the SNPs
   @pop: population of each individual (group size range: 25-68)
   @other: a list containing: loc.all.misformed  loc.metrics  ind.metrics  history


The loc.all slot is also empty, as if there was a problem in importation. Can anyone help ?
Thanks in advance,
Emmanuel

messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: Problem with the gl2fasta function
parts:
Hi Emmanuel,

Your loc.all slot needs to contain data like this.

tests...@loc.all
  [1] "A/G" "C/T" "T/G" "A/T" "C/T" "A/T" "C/T" "G/T" "T/G" "G/A" "G/T" "T/G" "C/T" "T/G"
 [15] "C/T" "G/A" "T/A" "C/T" "G/A" "C/G" "C/G" "A/T" "T/G" "T/A" "A/T" "G/A" "A/G" "T/A"

otherwise the script cannot calculate ambiguity codes. Did you get your data from Diversity Arrays Technology or did you generate it yourself and migrate it to genlight.

A

parts:
Dear all,
Following my last message, I think I solved the problem:
just after the gl.read.dart command, I transfered the other$loc.all.misformed to @loc.all.

THEN I filtered the gl file (gl.filter.repavg; gl.filter.callrate)
toto contains 84 individuals with 5196 SNPs:

> toto
 /// GENLIGHT OBJECT /////////

 // 84 genotypes,  5,196 binary SNPs, size: 14.6 Mb
 14242 (3.26 %) missing data

 // Basic content
   @gen: list of 84 SNPbin
   @ploidy: ploidy of each individual  (range: 2-2)

 // Optional content
   @ind.names:  84 individual labels
   @loc.names:  5196 locus labels
   @loc.all:  5196 alleles
   @position: integer storing positions of the SNPs
   @pop: population of each individual (group size range: 23-61)
   @other: a list containing: loc.all.misformed  loc.metrics  ind.metrics  history


Then I exported the SNPs to fastA, and.. IT WORKED ! :-)))
> gl2fasta(toto, method=1, outfile="TRYFoc_SNPs.fasta", outpath="~/MesDonnées/MANU-180219/PROJETS/FOC BANANA/Data_Diane/DART data")

Assigning ambiguity codes to heterozygote SNPs, concatenating trimmed sequence
Not all snp position are within the length of the trimmed sequences. Those loci will be deleted ( 908 ).Generating haplotypes ... This may take some time
[1] TRUE

My next question : why does my fasta file contain sequences whose length is 281,141, whereas there should be 5,196 SNP positions ?

THanks for your help,
Manu

messages.author: d87216285ace7535
messages.subject: Re: Fwd: [dartR] Problem with the gl2fasta function
parts:
On Wed, September 4, 2019 11:13 pm, Emmanuel Paul Wicker wrote:
>
> My next question : why does my fasta file contain sequences whose length
> is 281,141, whereas there should be 5,196 SNP positions ?

method = 1 means that all the bases from that fragment are included. Thus
it is all the trimmed sequences.

If you only want the snp position then method = 3.

Check the help for an explanation of the options for method. ?gl2fasta

Cheers
Peter
